name: Banner of Vileness
body:
Price 4,000 gp; Aura faint abjuration; CL 5; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

All non-good allies within the radius gain the benefits of protection from good.

Cost 3,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells protection from good
